describe: The image shows a man's head and face seen from the front, lit evenly with the top of the head fading into black shadow: bushy dark brown hair at the sides and top, a pale tan forehead and cheeks, a blue-grey stubbly beard along the jaw, one dark brown eye on the viewer's left and a pale grey, blank eye on the right, a small flat nose and a downturned mouth, and large ears on either side. The bottom edge shows tan neck and shoulders.
